o 100% transparency
o Reviewed and curated quality
o Reduced lead times and assured delivery

GoCrazy is a Pakistan's first group buying social commerce marketplace that's reinventing the way people play, shop, & socialize.

Our unique approach combines discovery-based social sharing, community group buying, a gamified shopping experience, and next-generation payment solutions. Leveraging learnings from China and LatAm, and the sizable WhatsApp community in South Asia, the platform offers differentiated logistics to lower income neighborhoods with the main goal of connecting consumers to amazing products at “crazy low prices”.

We are on the mission of eliminating barriers to traditional e-commerce to provide low-income populations in Pakistan and throughout the Southern Asian region with better access to affordable products.

Put more simply, it aims to provide a more inclusive eCommerce experience that pays producers more and “sells cheaper” to those who buy products via our gamified app, which connects consumers to the best prices through community group purchases. Our model is super impactful because like most of Southern Asia, Pakistan is largely unbanked or underbanked (3rd largest unbanked country). So the ability to make online purchases without having to use a credit or debit card opens the door for many people who previously could not shop online and likely were paying higher costs for the same products in person.
